control_flow.failure_path: Strict validation raises a typed configuration error without echoing secret-like values
Invalid class, path, commit, or line range is rejected before an evidence ID is produced
No active bundle yields health 200, readiness 503, safe setup status, and profile INDEX_UNAVAILABLE

interfaces.contract: schema_version equals 1, unknown keys are rejected, localized required fields exactly match supported locales, secret keys are forbidden

fuse_rankings(rankings, weights, k=60) returns evidence IDs ordered by deterministic descending scores using sum(weight/(k+one_based_rank)), with evidence-ID tie-breaking, and rejects invalid k/weights/duplicates
chunk_text returns non-empty LF-normalized one-based inclusive LineChunk ranges bounded by maximum lines and characters with deterministic overlap
zh-TW and en have identical keys; translate rejects unsupported locales and unknown keys and interpolates only declared placeholders
healthz is 200, readyz is 503 before activation, status is setup_required without secrets, profile is 503 INDEX_UNAVAILABLE with X-Request-ID

failure_boundaries.boundary: untrusted YAML to validated public configuration
failure_boundaries.failure: unknown, secret, malformed, or locale-incomplete content
failure_boundaries.required_result: typed rejection with safe field paths and no secret value echo
stable localized error code and request ID without internal diagnostics

invariants.statement: Application files are created only after Technical Specification 0.1.0 and the MVP sequencing decision are recorded as owner-approved
invariants.enforcement_owner: Root plan gate and repository documents
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Creating application source while the technical specification remains Draft or treating MVP as removal of complete-v1 requirements
invariants.counterexample: TECHNICAL_SPEC status is Draft while pyproject.toml exists, or delivery phases claim later FRs are dropped

invariants.statement: The normative example validates and unknown, secret, duplicate, invalid path, invalid URL, locale-incomplete, and invalid limit cases fail before side effects
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Ignoring unknown keys, accepting secrets in YAML, or returning raw secret-like values in errors
invariants.counterexample: A root api_key field or repository include ../secret validates successfully

invariants.statement: Evidence preserves its class, exact immutable source metadata, one-based inclusive range, and deterministic E_ plus 24 lowercase hex identifier
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Using mutable refs, model URLs, zero-based lines, or random evidence IDs
invariants.counterexample: Two identical records produce different IDs or an end line below the start line is accepted

invariants.statement: The real FastAPI entrypoint exposes the specified setup-state health, readiness, status, and profile behavior with request IDs and no sensitive diagnostics
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Reporting readiness without an index, returning profile 200 before activation, or exposing environment/provider values
invariants.counterexample: GET /readyz returns 200 or GET /api/public/status contains REPONPC_CHAT_BASE_URL

invariants.statement: Traditional Chinese and English expose the same MVP message keys and safe setup errors
invariants.prohibited_behavior: A missing locale key silently falls back or an untranslated key is exposed

invariants.statement: RRF implements the approved one-based formula deterministically and rejects invalid channel inputs
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Using zero-based rank, nondeterministic tie order, duplicate IDs in one channel, or non-finite weights
invariants.counterexample: The first record receives weight divided by k instead of k plus one

invariants.statement: Fallback chunks are deterministic, non-empty, one-based/inclusive, and bounded by configured line and character limits
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Dropping eligible text, emitting an over-limit chunk, or looping when overlap is configured
invariants.counterexample: A single overlong line creates a chunk above max_characters or overlap equal to max_lines never advances
